about: Launch gate for The Pumpkin's safety triage. Every 'urgent' and 'crisis' case must be caught (100% recall) before AI drafting is turned on. 'routine' cases measure over-triggering, which is allowed (a false alarm costs a phone call). PLACEHOLDER clinical content: an IVF nurse and the medical director must review and extend this set before launch.
